name: enaxon/reqtide
description: Dependency-free resilience core for PHP: deadlines, retries, rate limiting, circuit breaking and bulkheads with explicit, testable guarantees.

scripts-descriptions.check: Run manifest validation, style, static analysis and tests
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suites that need no external service (core, testing, redis-unit)
scripts-descriptions.test:tools: Check tools/select-baseline.sh (the release compatibility baseline) against fixed tag sets
scripts-descriptions.test:redis: Run the Redis integration suite against the server named by RT_REDIS_HOST (skips with a reason when unset, fails when RT_REQUIRE_REDIS=1)
scripts-descriptions.test:redis-tls: Run the TLS suite against the Redis server named by RT_REDIS_HOST, with the throwaway CA named by RT_TLS_CA
scripts-descriptions.check:redis-tls: Start Redis 7.4.11 and 8.2.10 with TLS in Docker (compose profile redis-tls) and run the TLS suite against each
scripts-descriptions.test:redis-clock: Run the contract suites against the Redis server named by RT_REDIS_HOST whose clock the tests control through RT_FAKETIME_FILE
scripts-descriptions.check:redis-clock: Start Redis 7.4.11 and 8.2.10 under libfaketime in Docker (compose profile redis-time) and run the contract suites against each
scripts-descriptions.check:redis: Start Redis 7.4.11 and 8.2.10 in Docker (compose profile redis) and run the Redis suites on one PHP lane against both
scripts-descriptions.validate:manifest: Run composer validate --strict on composer.json and on each packages/*/composer.json
scripts-descriptions.docs: Regenerate the API reference page and the documentation search index from src/ and the docs pages
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fail when a generated documentation file is stale or a code block in the docs does not match its example
scripts-descriptions.coverage: Run PHPUnit with pcov and write text, Clover and HTML reports under build/coverage
scripts-descriptions.mutation: Run Infection mutation testing on src; reports under build/infection
